description: SLS v1.0.15 in the interim Telegram notifier. The notifier is stdlib-only and restates the R arithmetic outside the domain; each mutation is a way that restatement could price a TP the engine never judges against, announce a laddered signal under the pool-exit stop rule, or drop what the trailing stop booked. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/notifier_ladder.json

mutations.name: R is measured from the mid even for a risk stop
a short's rungs are priced above the entry
the ladder steps from TP1 instead of counting from it
a laddered signal is announced under the pool-exit rule
mutations.old: return ladder if isinstance(ladder, dict) and ladder else None

mutations.name: the close-the-loop message drops the booked R
the target column is no longer selected, so no signal ever shows a ladder
